text: My little sister is seven. She draws rainbows, birds and waterfalls.
Now imagine an AI turns her drawings into stories.
But who checks every page before she reads it? A hero's name goes missing. A lesson drifts. Even a word written on the drawing can start giving the AI orders.
So I'm building Storybound. It writes an oath first: six promises about what the story owes her. And it keeps them.
Every page is checked against the oath before she sees it. If a page breaks a promise, the agent rewrites it. Her parents get a receipt showing what was checked.
I'll build it this weekend with neatlogs to trace every run, Entire to remember why every change was made, and cfo.ai to plan the business.
Planning, tool use, state, context, execution, recovery, verification and iteration. All visible in one trace.
Follow along. Every claim will come with evidence you can open.
